🧭 How to use this dashboard

  • 18 Chapters — every chapter deep-dived through six lenses: essence, NLP, chakra, psyche, mental block, sadhana.
  • Explore 700 — every shloka in Sanskrit, IAST (with 🔊 pronunciation), Telugu script, Telugu meaning, two English translations, and word-by-word. Search & filter by theme, chakra, speaker.
  • Inner Science — Gita ↔ NLP map, the guna engine, yugas & the mind, the four paths to mukti (with a "which path fits me" selector), evolution across lifetimes, pronunciation rules.
  • Quiz — 10 random questions per round from a 30-question bank, with explanations.

🔗 The three shatkas — how the 18 chapters relate

Tradition reads the Gita as a mahavakya: chapters 1–6 = TVAM (you — karma & self-mastery), 7–12 = TAT (That — the divine, bhakti), 13–18 = ASI (are — the union, jnana). "Tat tvam asi — That thou art."
